verdict.rationale: The Freshworks CRM API docs list a 'Create Custom Modules' endpoint, so developers can define custom objects beyond the built-in contacts, accounts and deals. The pack gives only that endpoint title, with no detail on what a module can contain. Missing for 10: documentation of custom field types on modules, relationships/lookups between custom modules and built-in objects, CRUD/query of custom module records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
